additional_context: CapabilityStatement is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. Later Published issue FHIR-34234 expanded the same operation-name guidance to explain that CapabilityStatement.rest.[resource.]operation.name usually follows OperationDefinition.code but may differ for disambiguation, preserving the FHIR-36559 correction. Zulip discussion and FHIR-I minutes align with the same clarification intent.
